extraction.notes: IRT reports FFO and CFFO (Core FFO) only; no AFFO metric, so affo fields are null. Starting line and all reconciling items taken from the three-months-ended June 30, 2022 column of the FFO/CFFO table (seq 247). Gain on sale of real estate and loss on extinguishment lines show '—' for Q2 2022 and were omitted. Recurring capex of $7.1 million (quarter, total portfolio) is from the Capital Expenditures text on seq 222; it is rounded in the filing, so 7,100 is the printed rounded figure. Diluted share count uses 227,966,261 units/shares (printed in full), divided by 1,000 to match thousands; reproduces FFO $0.29 and CFFO $0.26 per share. Table column labeled 'Weighted-average shares and units outstanding' in the 2022 three-month column matches the trailing table value.
